title: Agent Speedup v2 User Check 7.1 — LIBERO-10 Technical Notes

scope.release: Version A including A9; excludes E1, E2 image rotation, UC8 changes
scope.evidence_policy: Static source inspection only. No model, simulator or new scene-test calls performed for this document.

architecture.summary: A persistent multimodal executive owns task interpretation, geometric estimates, route/grasp choice, visual verification and recovery. A deterministic executor accepts bounded commands, observes measured feedback and returns control. The independent evaluator owns success and physical truth.

components.name: Preparation
components.role: Official task registry + frozen custom initial state -> reset observation -> one structured plan draft; stores zero policy actions, images, runtime/configuration inventory, view frame and model budget.

components.name: ReviewStore / browser UI
components.role: Human inspects initial plan and grounding, edits selectors, checks every intent and approves a context-bound revision. Review server never invokes runner/model/simulator.

components.name: PlanLock + task contract
components.role: Preserves initial goals, entity identity, regions and applicable constraints while allowing model-selected execution order, grips and recovery methods. Approval scope is initial_plan_only.

components.name: AgentFirstV2Client
components.role: Two synchronized RGB images + current measured state, camera/gripper geometry, capabilities and persistent history -> strict JSON decision.

components.name: AgentFirstV2Policy
components.role: Dispatches execute/motion/optional macro; returns fresh feedback at each boundary; records model belief separately from robot measurements.

components.name: Fragment / short-target executor
components.role: Task-independent OSC conversion and bounded numerical feedback; no object identity, grasp certificate or task success oracle.

components.name: Independent evaluator / recorder
components.role: Official stopping signal, terminal strict truth, after-settle diagnostics, contact log, video, requests and full audit; hidden truth not sent to policy.

architecture.loop: observe -> executive strict JSON -> validate -> bounded measured action(s) -> handoff/feedback + fresh RGB -> executive
architecture.caveat: Optional native macro apparatus is retained, but its registration/grasp prerequisites are not universal gates on model-owned direct control.

configuration.billing: ChatGPT subscription/OAuth; API-key calls must remain zero
configuration.initial_state: Official index 0 / seed 7; current campaign uses physically validated rearranged object XY
configuration.reset_settle: 10 environment setup actions, excluded from policy action count
configuration.episode_caps: No full-task wall time, action or call cap; fragment bounds are local

planning.allowed: Task text + external/wrist plan images (clean and gridded); no camera calibration in initial/replan request.
planning.direction_instruction: Use image-1 viewer directions; metric distances/heights may be prose but do not command motion.

allowed: state8-derived measured grip-site position/right-hand orientation/finger joints
seven measured arm-joint positions and velocities
allowlisted camera calibration and fixed gripper geometry
official task language and reviewed goal contract
executive beliefs, accepted decisions and measured action feedback

observation_boundary.separation: Simulator agent_geometry is separate from evaluator geometry/truth/settle_truth operations. Cached robot measurements share the RGB observation timestamp. Wrist pose_source must be observed_robot_pose_fixed_mount.
observation_boundary.reset_hash_caveat: CalibratedObservation.to_dict preserves original state8 reset identity; joint channels are explicitly removed from that serialization. Do not describe initial_observation_sha256 as a hash of every execution-visible sensor field.

plan_schema.grid: 8×8; 1–64 row-major from top left; 0 means not visible

steps.schema_count: 0–6; review semantic validator requires at least one

fields.until: 0–3 objects {o: effect|stop|fits|quarter_turn|half_turn, p: A–H|null, txt: string<=40|null}

semantic_validation: Plan must round-trip exactly; non-ASCII text that base parser would sanitize is rejected for review.
At least one intent, valid part references, no duplicate IDs, appropriate move priors, grip-object consistency and criterion rules.
For non-slide steps, sense must be any; ref allowed only for place_on/place_in/push_to; release grip list must be empty.
Stop/angle criterion p must be null; descriptive txt only for effect.
Region IDs unique, existing and not their own support/anchor; support/anchor must be physical parts, not other regions.
All region relations other than on need anchor; near needs explicit bounds; numeric bounds finite and increasing.
Placement pair unique, known IDs, non-region object; positive finite tolerance or null.
Active clear_of that contradicts required manipulation contact is flagged.
plan_schema.important_distinction: All seven do values are legal reviewed task intents for agent control. Only hold/turn/place_on/release have optional native macro implementations. Do not describe place_in as invalid in the current executive.
plan_schema.parser_compatibility: Strict model output requires regions and placement_goals, normally [] when unused; older persisted native plans without these arrays remain readable by parser.

approval_and_ui.review_state_machine: draft -> approved -> consumed; updating a plan creates draft state again and clears approval
approval_and_ui.context_hash: SHA256(canonical JSON of immutable context fields); preparation includes execution options and frozen view_frame
approval_and_ui.state_hash: SHA256(all persisted review fields except state_sha256)
approval_and_ui.optimistic_concurrency: update/approve require matching expected_revision; stale revisions rejected
approval_and_ui.selector_edit_scope: Scene text cannot change. Selected parts must preserve original id/text/w/x. Effect descriptions must come from draft. Selectors such as move and step fields may change subject to exact schema and semantic validation.
approval_and_ui.edit_recheck: If the plan changes, checked-step list is cleared. Every step must be checked to approve.
approval_and_ui.one_use: claim checks approved status, task/episode, initial observation identity and full runtime/configuration hash mapping; writes durable .review-claimed.json before consumed state so a crash fails closed.
approval_and_ui.ordering: execute_reviewed claims before first execution model request. Actual reset mismatch later still consumes this attempt with zero policy actions.
approval_and_ui.ui: Loopback only (127.0.0.1/localhost). Private fragment-token URL; bearer API auth, Host/Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site checks. UI only reads/updates/approves one ReviewStore; approval does not itself execute.
approval_and_ui.authorized_replanning: Initial goals/constraints persist; automatic execution adaptation is model authority, not another human approval.

direction_contract.unavailable: No external calibration, or norm(R[:2,0]) < 1e-9 (camera_x_vertical); no fallback to fixed world axes
direction_contract.diagnostic_roll: roll_deg = degrees(atan2(R[2,0],R[2,1])) unless both up components zero; inverted = R[2,1] < 0
storage_flow: build_view_frame(external calibration + image conventions) at prepare
task contract receives region_directions, including empty region lists
each executive request recomputes compact region_directions from frozen approval
solver and UI/log display consume shared mapping
direction_contract.solver: For an anchor polygon V and side vector d, keep support cell p only if p·d > max(v·d for v in V). Mask also requires measured/observed support and excludes known obstacle footprints.
direction_contract.bounds: frame=world denotes metric bounds coordinates; bounds relative to anchor centre if anchor supplied, otherwise absolute world. Prompt requests bounds=null for directional relations. Null directional bounds do not insert benchmark goal boxes.
direction_contract.a9: Highlights world ±x/±y in part text for human diagnostic attention only; does not mutate plan or add validator veto.
direction_contract.wrist: Wrist image never defines task left/right. UC7.1 changes planning wording, not image rotations.
direction_contract.limitations: This is a global horizontal convention, not a local perspective Jacobian. Off-centre projection and large roll/inversion can disagree with pixel directions; inverted views are diagnosed but not vetoed. Do not infer universal camera support or direction-repair validation from nondirectional t0/t1 basket plans.

fields.plan: string 1–1800, model execution strategy (not a replacement structured review plan)

branch_rules.effect: Validated 1–6 segment fragment sequence; fresh measured feedback/RGB at handoff.
Short target {frame:world, position_mode:absolute|relative, xyz_m:[3], quaternion_wxyz:[4]|null, gripper:keep|open|close, steps:1..5}; no recovery_goal field in executive branch.
{step_index:nonnegative, budget_steps:1..60, continuation:boolean}; optional native hold/turn/place_on/release. Selection uses initial approved steps. continuation needs same paused macro index.
One measured-pose hold action retaining previous gripper command, then fresh image.
Records model completion claim and one measured-pose hold; cannot stop or set evaluator success.

executive_response.dispatch: At most one executive answer per act(). Rejected command receives explicit observation hold; next model call sees measured feedback. No automatic episode retry/repair cap is introduced here.

target_rules: move_to_pose uses absolute world XYZ. move_relative and approach resolve a world displacement once from measured segment-entry pose.
Approach requires contact profile. All arm motion requires gripper=keep; opening/closing is a separate set_gripper segment.
Null orientation keeps measured segment-entry orientation; nonnull is absolute world quaternion_wxyz, normalized on validation.
set_gripper and wait require null XYZ and quaternion. set_gripper holds entry pose while commanding fingers; wait retains entry pose and command.
All fields validated before actions. Each segment rechecks translation/rotation envelope against its own measured entry, including later segments.
Target rejection may issue zero actions for that segment; action translation clipped by profile and rotation by0.1rad.

measured_completions.pose: Position and orientation tolerance hold for 2 consecutive measured samples; entry measurement may count, but completion only acknowledged after a real action.
measured_completions.gripper: At least8 opening or12 closing actions, 5 recent gaps spanning<=0.6mm, and2 pose-arrival samples. This is gap stability, not a grasp certificate.

handoff_conditions.complete: All segments satisfy measured completion predicates.
handoff_conditions.checkpoint: observation_after=true or completed wait stops sequence; later segments remain unexecuted.
handoff_conditions.stalled: Motion segment after>=16 actions: over12 most recent samples, weighted error e=position_error_m+0.05*orientation_error_rad improves by<0.0008m; yields segment_stall.
handoff_conditions.gap_change: While maintaining close outside set_gripper, gap rises>=6mm above observed minimum for3 consecutive samples; yields maintained_grip_gap_changed.
handoff_conditions.budget: max_steps expires before predicate or execution limit reached.
handoff_conditions.envelope: Target too far, rotated too much, or nonfinite.

fragments.continuation: No implicit retry or resume. After any checkpoint/intervention the model must submit a new sequence from current observation; pending segments never autoplay.
fragments.epistemic_limit: Measured pose/gap success does not prove object identity, grasp, support, collision-free path or task success. Stall does not certify contact or global impossibility.

persistent_history.retention: All executive textual observations, accepted outputs and measured feedback; latest6 image pairs including current request; accepted opaque encrypted reasoning items replayed.
persistent_history.first_request: Includes reviewed_goal_contract.initial_plan and task_contract. Later requests retain them in text history; region_directions explicitly reattached on every request.
persistent_history.state_separation: shared state labels measured_robot, native_estimate and model_estimate separately; task_success remains unknown_to_policy.
persistent_history.compaction: Current evidence text >45,000 chars triggers only large execution/native/feedback compaction with stage outcomes and causal details prioritized; goals and sensor geometry preserved. Request rejected above56,000 chars. Full audit stays on disk.
persistent_history.usage: 1400 visible-token target tracked for executive responses, not a total task call cap.

transport.deadline: 180s after authentication, covering serialization, HTTP open and complete SSE stream; POSIX main-thread SIGALRM + monotonic checks; not episode budget or socket timeout.
transport.partial_output: Not executable; strict completed response envelope required.
transport.retry_eligibility: Only before any response envelope exists and before observation count changes / history commit.
transport.overload: error_code=server_is_overloaded AND http_status in {503,None}: max2 retries for that category.
transport.transient: stream_missing_completion, stream_truncated_event, subscription_stream_interrupted, subscription_network_error: aggregate max2 retries for this category.
transport.independent_counts: Overload and transient counters independent. Mixed failures can exceed3 total sends; do not promise one universal3-send ceiling.
transport.backoff: Base2 exponential + uniform0..1s jitter, at least server retry_after_s; reject retry if computed wait>60s.
transport.not_retryable: HTTP520/unknown_error, request_deadline_exceeded, and arbitrary503 errors without matching overload code; no task-level rerun.
transport.diagnostics: requests/<UUID>.stream.json logs content-free phase/timing/counts/allowlisted metadata. Retry logs record same observation, no committed history, zero actions from failed response.

evaluation_and_limits.stopping: Official LIBERO success stops; model finish and local primitive success are not task completion. Collision monitor is record-only.
evaluation_and_limits.hold_only_exception: Do not equate v2_success with after-settle success. Exception requires every failed terminal subcheck qualify terminal_failure_is_hold_only plus raw+strict diagnostic success. Support failures excluded.
evaluation_and_limits.timing: Only eligible official-success cases: task_completion_time_s=control_elapsed_s-video_render_s. Includes execution model waiting, local computation and sim steps; excludes preparation/review/reset, terminal diagnostics and cleanup.
evaluation_and_limits.current_evidence: t0/t1 are one attempt each on custom layouts, not full LIBERO-10 sweep. They have no directional region relation, so they do not validate directional repair. No speedup claim without comparable completed baseline.
evaluation_and_limits.contact_counts: Repeated contact points/samples are not counts of independent collision incidents.

technical_caveats_for_author: The word plan occurs twice: initial typed goal/intent plan, and executive plan string describing its strategy. Keep them visually distinct.
Do not copy old v3 no-calibration/RGB-only or strict macro-only handoff descriptions into current UC7.1.
Do not label native placement verification as universal executive gate; direct control can finish subtasks without native certification, independent evaluator decides.
Do not state that only initial approved step order/grips can execute; persistent goals and applicable constraints, not exact method, are the continuing contract.
Do not say all request retries disabled or every error retries twice.
Review file integrity hashes are reproducibility/freshness mechanisms, not cryptographic identity/authentication proof of a particular human.
Source displays several legacy component versions; framework version7.1 coexists with agent prompt3 / client2 / policy3 / fragment1. Do not conflate component version strings.
Planning video arrows are derived current-fragment target-error control fields, not a computed obstacle field or safety certificate.
bounds=null directional side is not narrowed to evaluator benchmark region; retain this distinction in diagrams.
